name: Boron

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: An ultratrace element with reported effects on sex hormone binding globulin and free testosterone in small studies. The evidence base is thin and the studies are small.

systems.note: Taken for its reported effect on SHBG and free testosterone; the intended effect, on thin evidence.

monitors.why: The reported mechanism; a fall in SHBG is what the small studies describe.
